summary: At a quarter before midnight the four men enter the Kingstead churchyard and Van Helsing shows Arthur and Quincey the empty coffin. Outside, Van Helsing seals the tomb door with crumbled Host mixed into putty; they hide as Lucy, the 'Bloofer Lady', approaches carrying a child, her mouth bloody. She tries to lure Arthur ('Come to me'), is repelled by the golden crucifix, and cannot enter the sealed tomb until Van Helsing removes the Host and she slips in through the crack. The next night, after the funeral and the sexton's locking-up, Van Helsing prepares the tomb with a soldering iron, solder, oil lamp, operating knives, a charred stake and a hammer. He explains the curse of the Un-Dead; Arthur drives the stake through Lucy while Van Helsing reads from the missal. She turns back into her peaceful self, the stake is sawed, the head cut off, the mouth filled with garlic and the lead coffin soldered shut. The party vows to hunt the author of the sorrow; Van Helsing leaves for Amsterdam.

scenes.title: Return to the empty coffin
scenes.time: 11:45 pm, 29 September, dark with moon gleams
scenes.summary: Van Helsing leads them in, closes the door, lights a dark lantern, removes the lid and lets Arthur see the cut lead and the empty coffin.

scenes.title: Quincey's challenge and Van Helsing's account
scenes.summary: Quincey asks if Van Helsing did this; he swears no and explains the garlic on the clamps last night and its removal tonight.
scenes.key_quote: I swear to you by all that I hold sacred that I have not removed nor touched her.

scenes.title: Sealing the tomb with the Host
scenes.summary: Van Helsing crumbles consecrated wafers into putty and lays strips in the door crevices so the Un-Dead cannot enter.
scenes.key_quote: The Host. I brought it from Amsterdam. I have an Indulgence.

scenes.title: The Bloofer Lady returns
scenes.location: Avenue of yews and tomb door
scenes.summary: A white figure with a child advances; moonlight shows Lucy with bloody lips. She throws down the child, invites Arthur to her arms, is stopped by the crucifix, and cannot pass the sealed door.
scenes.key_quote: Come to me, Arthur. Leave these others and come to me.

scenes.title: Lucy enters the tomb
scenes.summary: Arthur gives consent; Van Helsing removes some Host and Lucy passes through the crack as a corporeal body; he restores the seal.
scenes.key_quote: pass in through the interstice where scarce a knife-blade could have gone.

scenes.title: Returning the child
scenes.summary: The child is left where police will find it; Van Helsing tells Arthur he is in the 'bitter waters'.
scenes.key_quote: You are now in the bitter waters, my child.

scenes.title: Preparations for the stake
scenes.summary: All in black, the men wait out the funeral and sexton, then Van Helsing lays out solder, lamp, knives, stake and hammer and explains the curse of the Un-Dead.
scenes.key_quote: they cannot die, but must go on age after age adding new victims

scenes.title: Arthur drives the stake
scenes.summary: Arthur holds the stake over the heart; with the prayer for the dead he strikes; Lucy shrieks and writhes, blood spurts, then lies still and becomes sweet Lucy again.
scenes.key_quote: He looked like a figure of Thor

scenes.title: Finishing the work
scenes.summary: Arthur kisses her; Arthur and Quincey leave; Van Helsing and Seward saw off the stake top, cut off the head, fill the mouth with garlic, solder the lead coffin and screw the lid.
scenes.key_quote: Then we cut off the head and filled the mouth with garlic.

scenes.title: The vow
scenes.summary: Van Helsing proposes the hunt for the author of their sorrow; each takes his hand; dinner is set for two nights hence at seven, he will bring two unknown helpers.
scenes.key_quote: once our feet are on the ploughshare we must not draw back.

puzzles.name: Sealing the tomb
puzzles.setup: Stop Lucy re-entering the tomb until the men are ready.
puzzles.obstacle: Seal narrow door crevices with a ward she will respect.
puzzles.book_solution: Crumble Host with putty and roll thin strips.
puzzles.game_idea: Crafting-and-placement puzzle: fill every gap in a door frame with strips; leave one gap unsealed to let her in at the right time.
puzzles.quote: rolling it into thin strips, began to lay them into the crevices

puzzles.name: Choosing the hunter's hand
puzzles.book_solution: Van Helsing frames it as a blessed act; Arthur steps forward.
puzzles.game_idea: Dialogue choice giving the killing blow to a party member, with stat effects.
puzzles.quote: Tell me if there be such a one amongst us?

puzzles.name: Soldering the coffin shut
puzzles.setup: Seal lead coffin after the destruction.
puzzles.book_solution: Blue-flame oil lamp heats soldering iron; solder the seam.
puzzles.game_idea: Seam-sealing mini-game: trace the lead seam with the iron without burning.
puzzles.quote: We soldered up the leaden coffin, screwed on the coffin-lid

puzzles.name: Waiting out the sexton
puzzles.book_solution: Dress in black, stroll about, hide until the gate is locked.
puzzles.game_idea: Timing/stealth puzzle: stay outside the sexton's line of sight until the gate is locked.

combat.name: Confrontation at the tomb door
combat.tactics: Hide behind yews, reveal with lantern, line up before the tomb, hold the crucifix between her and the door; she stands paralysed between crucifix and sealed door.
combat.outcome: She cannot pass or flee; Van Helsing opens the seal and she retreats into the tomb.
combat.game_idea: Turn-based standoff: Lucy has seduce/charm and snarl moves against Arthur; party uses Crucifix (hold), Lantern (reveal), and Host seal (block) to pin her in place. Charm resist test for Arthur.
combat.quote: she remained between the lifted crucifix and the sacred closing of her means of entry

combat.name: The staking of Lucy
combat.tactics: Reveal body by lantern; Arthur places point over heart, Van Helsing reads the prayer, stake is struck on cue; later decapitate and fill mouth with garlic.
combat.outcome: Lucy writhes, screams, stills, regains her peaceful form; coffin soldered shut.
combat.game_idea: Ritual boss encounter with three phases: prayer (party chants, morale bar), strike (timing meter), post-ritual (behead, garlic, solder). Failure to maintain nerve causes Lucy's counter-screams to drain sanity.
combat.quote: Then he struck with all his might.
